genomes.name: Flush, Washout or Squeeze
genomes.thesis: Buys forced selling and quiet: 1.56 times normal volume near the lower Bollinger band, a volatility squeeze (20-day volatility under 68% of 60-day), an RSI(7) washout under 24, or a 1.2% drop on 1.5 times volume. Sells when RSI(7) recovers past 59, within 1.3% of the 52-week high, or after seven sessions; 3% stop, 3.7% target.
genomes.rationale: Bred in the first quick-trade run: generation 9, a crossover of two leaders.
